answer: Tenure-weighted influence makes fresh keys nearly worthless, so minting them buys a farm little. Each key's vote and reward weight starts at 1 and rises one step per epoch of verified work, up to 8; any missed or failed epoch drops it back to 1, a spiral that cannot be sold or merged. Work is key-bound: each task, such as grading a sonnet translation, arrives under a cipher tied to one address, so one answer cannot feed two keys. 1,000 new fakes weigh 1,000 against 500 veterans at 4,000, and aging them all takes 8,000 real jobs. Weakness: patient farms, so the cap stays low.
